autofix.description: compose autofix preset: confluent fixes on / all error / pass silent (default: repair; layer: POLICY)

compose_rhythm.description: auto-fix sibling rhythm violations; false warns only (default: true; layer: POLICY)

deck.description: Deck bundler/serve settings (SPEC-SAIL-CONFIG-1); nested only — top-level render/entry/injectGlobals refuse as unknown (default: absent — fully conventional serve defaults (csr, no entry, no inject); layer: POLICY)
deck.x-sail-type: { render?: "csr"|"ssr", entry?: { clientsModule, exposeNames[] }, injectGlobals?: { [k]: template } }

editor.description: studio deep-link preference for open-in-editor — product taste, not language behavior (default: vscode (studio default when unset); layer: TASTE)

fonts.description: pin font roles (body, heading, mono, display, app-custom) to Fontsource package ids or local faces; unused families do not ship (default: omitted — vendored @ship/tokens FONTS + theme --font-*-app (no regression); layer: PRODUCT)

icons.description: icon pack pin + role→glyph map (SPEC-ICONS-1). Author markup uses roles, never pack prefixes (default: framework default pack lucide + core role table (no app overrides); layer: PRODUCT)
icons.x-sail-type: { pack?: string | { id, version? }, version?, packs?: { [id]: { version } }, roles?: { [role]: glyph | "pack:glyph" | { pack, glyph } } }

layout.description: promote gate-gap layout findings (main-axis overflow, collapsed box, height-chain) to Error so check/dev exit non-zero (studio strict profile) (default: warn — taffy soft findings stay warnings; silent-clip stays Error; layer: POLICY)

layoutExperimental.description: enable experimental layout kinds (sub-min-tap-target) without full lint strict (SPEC-LAYOUT-DIAG-1 / S4.1) (default: false; layer: POLICY)

layoutTextMetrics.description: kill switch for text-metrics layout kind clipped-text (LAYOUT-5 default on; false disables) (default: false; layer: POLICY)

lint.description: global lint severity floor + per-rule overrides (SPEC-LINTS-1 §3); dual-read with policy.lint.severity.* (default: natural rule severities (no global floor, no per-rule tree); layer: POLICY)

network.description: fetch/WebSocket/EventSource allowlist; [] grants nothing explicitly; a wrong-typed value fails closed (default: absent = full refusal; layer: POLICY)

policy.description: typed compiler policy registry object; unknown keys are a hard error naming the closest valid key (default: registry defaults (see `sail-compiler policy`); layer: POLICY)

preset.description: select a capability tier above the floor in one word (default: no tier — capabilities opt in individually; layer: POLICY)

raw_containers.description: capability override: allow raw container elements instead of the layout keywords (default: off; layer: POLICY)

strict.description: every lint finding is Error at the build gate (Warn→Error); per-rule off still silences; never downgrades compiler errors (default: false; layer: POLICY)

stylesheets.description: the CSS files this package may ship; an undeclared stylesheet fails the floor check (default: none; layer: POLICY)

sx.description: capability override: allow the sx surface beyond the floor allowance (default: off; layer: POLICY)

theme.description: app theme emit set: default id, optional mode, catalog allowlist (omit/[] thin; "all" full; list filter). Project themes/ always emit (default: no theme section — thin app emit (no catalog); package generate still full catalog; layer: POLICY)

unconfined.description: opt out of controller ambient-authority confinement entirely; a wrong-typed value stays confined (default: confined; layer: POLICY)

variants.description: capability override: allow CVA-in-props variance matrices (key→sx maps on props) and compound: (default: off; layer: POLICY)
